notes: «أن أبا هريرة، أخبره أن عمر بن الخطاب بينا هو يخطب» : Abu Hurayra is the witness-transmitter; Umar is the subject of the scene and quotes the Prophet inside it («أولم تسمعوا رسول الله يقول»)
whether Umar is a link after Abu Hurayra (rule 6) is not settled, so he is not written and a ruling is needed
